verdict.rationale: SumUp can be driven non-interactively. Static API keys let an application act on a merchant's behalf, the @sumup/sdk runs in Node.js 18+ and serverless runtimes, and the Cloud API starts reader transactions over plain HTTPS. Sandbox merchant accounts and Virtual Solo support automated testing without hardware. However, there is no documented CLI, headless mode or CI-specific guidance, so the automation story is implied by the API rather than explicitly delivered. Missing for 10: an official CLI or documented CI/headless workflow, CI integration examples, and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: API keys are static credentials that let your application act on behalf of the merchant account that created the key.
works in modern JavaScript runtimes and platforms, including Node.js 18+, Cloudflare Workers, Vercel, and other ESM-friendly environments
Use Virtual Solo together with a sandbox merchant account to test the pairing and checkout flow first, then switch to a physical reader later
SumUp provides sandbox merchant accounts and a comprehensive set of test cards to simulate various payment scenarios
